human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Before code, freeze the OpenGap MVP: one researcher persona, one golden user loop, deterministic potential-gap rules, evidence-first output, and the hard OpenAIRE submission requirements. Do not design a general research-intelligence platform.
human_pressure.why_now: The deadline is next day; ambiguity now creates rework later.
do_not_misread: This is a 40-hour effective deadline build, not a platform foundation exercise.
Preserve the IDEA → ANALYZE → POTENTIAL GAP → WHY → EVIDENCE → REFINE user loop.
red_lines: Do not start implementation before the product and scope docs are frozen.
Do not expand the primary persona set.
Do not introduce an opportunity score or autonomous agent workflow.

machine_core.goal: Create the minimum repository documentation that freezes product value, MVP scope, architecture, methodology, deadline plan, and submission definition of done.
red_lines: Do not start implementation before the product and scope docs are frozen.
Do not expand the primary persona set.
Do not introduce an opportunity score or autonomous agent workflow.
invariants: Finding wording remains probabilistic/heuristic: potential gap, not proof.
OpenAIRE evidence remains central to the product.
failure_semantics: Missing docs are visible; do not silently proceed with ambiguous product scope.

steps.title: Write product brief
details: Define one primary user and one JTBD.
Use potential-gap language, not opportunity claims.

steps.title: Freeze MVP and red lines
details: List P0, P1 and explicit out-of-scope items.
State that multi-agent, database, RAG and opportunity scoring are out.

steps.title: Document method and deadline
details: Document internal submission cutoff and kill order.

acceptance: MVP scope and non-goals are explicit.
Gap rules and methodological limits are documented.
Deadline runbook and submission DoD exist.
validate: test -f README.md && test -f docs/00-product-brief.md && test -f docs/02-mvp-scope.md && test -f docs/07-gap-detection-rules.md && test -f docs/10-48h-delivery-plan.md && test -f docs/12-definition-of-done.md && test -f LICENSE.md

must_check: MVP scope and non-goals are explicit.
Gap rules and methodological limits are documented.
Deadline runbook and submission DoD exist.
reject_if: Work expands beyond the declared file scope.

validation_notes: Greenfield task suite. Paths are established by earlier packs; run sequentially. Validation commands intentionally use repository-level npm scripts created by the scaffold pack instead of guessed test filenames unless the pack explicitly creates that test file.
expected_coder_final_response: Concise implementation summary, changed files, validation results, and an Evidence Matrix mapping acceptance items to concrete evidence.
